title: 苏联电气化的成就和远景
printed_title: 36. 苏联电气化的成就和远景

prose.text: The source textbook reports that the State Plan for the Electrification of Russia was adopted in 1920, and describes it as the first long-term national economic development plan in human history based on electrification. It identifies V. I. Lenin as the initiator and advocate of this plan. Lenin regarded electrification as decisive for transforming the national economy; this is the historical position recorded by the textbook.
prose.source_text: 1920 年通过了人类历史上第一个以电气化为基础的发展国民经济远景规划——俄罗斯国家电气化规划. В·И·列宁是制定这一计划的首创者和号召者. 列宁认为电气化在国家经济改造中有决定性的意义.

prose.text: The source textbook quotes V. I. Lenin: "Only when the country has been electrified, and only when the technological basis of modern large-scale industry has been introduced into industry, agriculture and transport, can we achieve final victory." This quotation expresses Lenin's political and economic judgment about electrification and economic transformation, rather than a law of physics.
prose.source_text: В·И·列宁说：“只有在国家实现电气化时，只有在把现代大规模的工业技术基础引入工业、农业和交通运输业中的时候，我们才能取得最后的胜利.”

prose.text:
The source textbook interprets the preceding half-century of development as evidence of the strength of Lenin's ideas; this is its historical assessment. It reports that, compared with 1913, the State Plan for the Electrification of Russia called for industrial production to double and electricity production to rise to 4 times the baseline.

According to the textbook, all targets had been exceeded after 10 years, ahead of the stipulated deadline. It also reports that the pace of electrification increased year by year and that, by 1947, the Soviet Union ranked first in Europe and second in the world in electricity production; these are historical rankings reported by the source, not current rankings.
prose.source_text: 过去的半个世纪令人信服地证明了列宁思想的伟大力量. 俄罗斯国家电气化规划规定了与 1913 年比较，工业生产要翻一番，电能的生产要增加到 4 倍. 这个计划在规定的期限之前（经过 10 年）全部指标都超额完成了. 电气化的速度年复一年的增长，到 1947 年苏联在电能生产上居欧洲第一位，居世界第二位.

prose.text: The source textbook reports that, in the period it describes, the Soviet Union produced nearly five times as much electrical energy in a day as it had produced during the whole of 1921, which it identifies as the first year of the national electrification plan. This comparison concerns total electrical energy, not generating power; the source's word "now" refers to its historical period, not the present day.
prose.source_text: 现在我国一天生产的电能是 1921 年（实行全国电气化计划的第一年）全年生产量的将近五倍.

prose.text:
The source textbook reports that hydropower accounted for about $20\%$ of the Soviet Union's electricity production at the time. It describes the Krasnoyarsk hydroelectric station, named to commemorate 50 years since the founding of the Soviet Union, as the world's largest hydroelectric station at that time.

The textbook reports that the station had hydroelectric generating units rated at 500000 kilowatts, which it describes as the most powerful such units in the world at the time. It gives the station's total power as six million kilowatts; these capacities and superlatives belong to the source's historical report and are not statements of current capacity or ranking.
prose.source_text: 水力发电站生产的电能占我国全部电能的 $20\%$ 左右. 世界上现今规模最大的水力发电站是以苏联建国 50 周年纪念日命名的克拉斯诺雅尔斯克水电站. 在这个水电站里安装了世界上最大功率（500000 千瓦特）的水轮机组. 这个电站的总功率达到六百万千瓦.

prose.text:
The source textbook reports that thermal power stations were also being developed toward greater power. It states that many Soviet thermal power stations at the time exceeded one million kilowatts, and that many of these exceeded two million kilowatts.

It gives the power of the Krivorozhsk thermal power station as three million kilowatts and describes it as the world's largest thermal power station at that time. These are the historical capacities and ranking reported by the textbook, not a comparison of present-day power stations.
prose.source_text: 至于火力发电站，它们也向增大功率的方向发展. 现在苏联大批火力发电站各站功率都超过一百万千瓦，其中很多功率超过二百万千瓦. 而克里沃罗日斯克火力发电站功率达到三百万千瓦，是现代世界上最大的火力发电站.

prose.text: The source textbook describes large nuclear power stations as playing an increasingly important role in electric power engineering at the time. It reports that a resolution of the twenty-fifth congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union called for priority development of nuclear energy in the European part of the Soviet Union. This passage reports the policy and development direction of that period, not present-day energy policy or a technical conclusion applicable to every region.
prose.source_text: 大功率的原子能发电站在电力工程上开始起着越来越大的作用，苏共第二十五次代表大会决议规定在苏联的欧洲部分优先发展原子能.

prose.text:
The source textbook reports that a unified all-Soviet power system was being formed by linking the power systems of Siberia and Central Asia with those in the European part of the Soviet Union. It presents this interconnection as a way to improve the reliability and flexibility of supply across the country's extensive territory; the actual effect depends on the grid and its operating conditions.

It also reports that this task required transmission trunk lines at 500000 volts, 750000 volts and 1150000 volts. These voltages and construction directions are part of the historical planning described by the source, not a claim that all such lines had already been completed at the time.
prose.source_text: 利用把西伯利亚和中亚的动力系统与我国欧洲部分的动力系统联合的方法，正在形成统一的全苏电力系统. 这就提高了在我国辽阔疆土上供电的可靠性和机动性. 解决这个任务要求建造 500000 伏、750000 伏和 1150000 伏的输电干线.

prose.text: 1920 年通过了人类历史上第一个以电气化为基础的发展国民经济远景规划——俄罗斯国家电气化规划. В·И·列宁是制定这一计划的首创者和号召者. 列宁认为电气化在国家经济改造中有决定性的意义.
В·И·列宁说：“只有在国家实现电气化时，只有在把现代大规模的工业技术基础引入工业、农业和交通运输业中的时候，我们才能取得最后的胜利.”
过去的半个世纪令人信服地证明了列宁思想的伟大力量. 俄罗斯国家电气化规划规定了与 1913 年比较，工业生产要翻一番，电能的生产要增加到 4 倍. 这个计划在规定的期限之前（经过 10 年）全部指标都超额完成了. 电气化的速度年复一年的增长，到 1947 年苏联在电能生产上居欧洲第一位，居世界第二位.
现在我国一天生产的电能是 1921 年（实行全国电气化计划的第一年）全年生产量的将近五倍.
水力发电站生产的电能占我国全部电能的 $20\%$ 左右. 世界上现今规模最大的水力发电站是以苏联建国 50 周年纪念日命名的克拉斯诺雅尔斯克水电站. 在这个水电站里安装了世界上最大功率（500000 千瓦特）的水轮机组. 这个电站的总功率达到六百万千瓦.
至于火力发电站，它们也向增大功率的方向发展. 现在苏联大批火力发电站各站功率都超过一百万千瓦，其中很多功率超过二百万千瓦. 而克里沃罗日斯克火力发电站功率达到三百万千瓦，是现代世界上最大的火力发电站.
大功率的原子能发电站在电力工程上开始起着越来越大的作用，苏共第二十五次代表大会决议规定在苏联的欧洲部分优先发展原子能.
利用把西伯利亚和中亚的动力系统与我国欧洲部分的动力系统联合的方法，正在形成统一的全苏电力系统. 这就提高了在我国辽阔疆土上供电的可靠性和机动性. 解决这个任务要求建造 500000 伏、750000 伏和 1150000 伏的输电干线.
